title: fix(marketplace): in-env install via same-origin route (fix cross-origin CORS)
body:
**Browser-reproduced** the user's "can't install from inside the environment": the in-env marketplace install dialog showed **"Failed to fetch"**.

**Root cause**: inside a tenant runtime (crm.objectos.app) `installPackage()` POSTed to the *separate* cloud origin `${cloudBase}/api/v1/actions/sys_package/install_package` with `credentials:'include'` — a cross-origin, cross-site-cookie request the browser blocks (CORS / SameSite) → "Failed to fetch".

**Fix**: when `getCloudBase()` is non-empty (tenant runtime, cloud is another origin), install POSTs **same-origin** to `/api/v1/cloud-connection/install` — the route the cloud-owned runtime plugin mounts (cloud PR #50), which authorizes via the **env session** and forwards to cloud **server-to-server** (no CORS, no leaked cross-site cookie). Env is resolved by hostname server-side. Cloud control-plane path (`getCloudBase()===''`) unchanged.

Verified: route works end-to-end on staging (200, package installed); `@object-ui/app-shell` build clean. Pairs with cloud #50 + docs/design/cloud-account-binding-marketplace-install.md.
